 Noah Kahan is heading back on tour in 2027 for his biggest outing yet.
 The “Last of the Bugs World Tour” will see Kahan performing stadium shows across the US, Canada, Europe, and the UK throughout spring and summer 2027. The 31-date trek arrives in support of The Great Divide , Kahan’s most recent album.
 Get Noah Kahan Tickets Here 
 The tour will kick off on April 24th in Athens, Georgia, followed by stops in Birmingham, Tampa, Nashville, Charlotte, Norman, Houston, Austin, San Francisco, Las Vegas, and Madison. After a four-show run at Boston’s Fenway Park, Kahan will make stops in Columbus, Detroit, Buffalo, and Montreal before wrapping up the North American leg on June 18th at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium. He’ll then head to Europe for the next leg of the tour. See Kahan’s full list of tour dates below.
 Advertisement 
 Tickets for Noah Kahan’s The Last of the Bugs World Tour will be available through the following presales and general onsale:
 Artist Presale (North America): Tuesday, November 10th at 12:00 p.m. local time via Ticketmaster . Fans must register here by Thursday, November 5th at 11:59 p.m. ET.
 Artist Presale (Europe): Tuesday, November 10th at 12:00 p.m. local time via Ticketmaster . Fans must register here by Monday, November 9th at 5:00 p.m. local time.
 Reserved by Spotify Presale (North America): Wednesday, November 11th at 9:00 a.m. local time for eligible U.S. Spotify Premium subscribers.
 General Onsale (All Dates): Thursday, November 12th at 12:00 p.m. local time via Ticketmaster and NoahKahan.com.
 Mastercard Preferred Tickets (North America): Available to eligible cardholders for select dates through The Mastercard Collection. No specific sale date was provided.
 North American tickets purchased through Ticketmaster will also be subject to Face Value Exchange restrictions, limiting resale to face value on the platform.
 Related Video 
 Kahan revealed The Great Divide , his fourth album, on April 24th. He spent much of 2026 on the road in support of the album, embarking on “The Great Divide Tour” back in June; he still has a stretch of dates left on the tour in the UK and Europe. Revisit our 2024 cover story on Kahan , who discussed his love of live music, his songwriting style, and maintaining his “northern attitude.”
